response.sql: WITH execution_counts AS (SELECT ordersmark AS order_reference, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), shares AS (SELECT order_reference, execution_count, 1.0 * execution_count / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share FROM execution_counts), differences AS (SELECT order_reference, execution_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_difference FROM shares), ranked AS (SELECT order_reference, execution_count, share, share_difference, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share_difference DESC NULLS LAST) AS share_rank FROM differences) SELECT order_reference, execution_count, share, share_difference FROM ranked WHERE share_rank <= 10 ORDER BY share_difference DESC NULLS LAST;
